rows.label: Flat DEX
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 DEX = 1 Attack, 1 STR = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: DEX %
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 DEX = 1 Attack, 1 STR = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: STR
rows.semantics: adds the main stat's flat-Attack channel (1 DEX = 1 Attack, 1 STR = 0.25 Attack, before ATTACK%) next to STAT_DAMAGE

rows.label: FINAL_DAMAGE % (multiplicative source)
rows.semantics: the +1% multiplicative step bumps the whole Final Damage bracket, including the live Mortal Blow share (Current / New include it)

rows.label: CRIT_RATE %
rows.semantics: Book of Ancient (if equipped): Crit Damage follows the crit-rate change

rows.label: ATTACK_SPEED % (diminishing returns, factor 150)
rows.semantics: Athena's Gloves (if equipped): Max Damage follows; Bottle of Emotion (if equipped): Final Damage follows

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 1st Job
rows.semantics: adds Critical Shot's (Crit Rate) and Archer Mastery's (Attack Speed) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 2nd Job
rows.semantics: adds Bow Acceleration's (Attack Speed), Physical Training's (Basic Attack Damage), Bow Mastery's (Min Damage) and Soul Arrow: Bow's (Attack%) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 3rd Job
rows.semantics: adds Reckless Hunt: Bow's Final Damage level delta

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — 4th Job
rows.semantics: adds Armor Break's (Final Damage, Defense Penetration) and Bow Expert's (Skill Damage, Max Damage) level deltas

rows.label: Skill Level Bonus — All Skills
rows.semantics: adds every passive's level delta (Critical Shot, Archer Mastery, Bow Acceleration, Physical Training, Bow Mastery, Reckless Hunt, Armor Break, Bow Expert, Soul Arrow)

rows.label: Pig's Ribbon
rows.reason: stat not used by the DPS model (no attacking effect)

rows.label: Mushmom's Cap
rows.reason: stat not used by the DPS model (Accuracy vs Evasion not modelled)

rows.label: Lunar Dew
rows.reason: stat not used by the DPS model (no attacking effect)
